component: OAuth custom issuer flags and Exchange settings

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: This landing moves usePKCE out of the truthy string override loop and assigns usePKCE and useExternalBrowser directly from custom details. A supplied false therefore replaces an existing issuer Boolean value instead of being skipped as an empty string override would be. Exchange's preference getters initialize PKCE to false and external-browser use to true, while the actual browser branch also requires a global preference. Unit assertions directly check the resulting OAuth object flags; the browser test toggles the controls without adding explicit post-save assertions for those two incoming-server values. No provider,redirect,crypto or native UI result was executed here.
title: Custom OAuth Boolean flags replace issuer defaults even when the value is false
